text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Leader Tamamo, sorry to bother you! 
There's something I'm having a hard time 
judging...! Could you take a quick look?

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Leader Tamamo! Could you help us out over 
here later too? Please save us~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, got it, got it! Just gimme a sec!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A complete shift from when she had just 
become leader, Tamamo Cross was now 
someone everyone heavily relied on.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Phew, today was so busy!
choice_data_list: You've really built up your prestige, huh.

You've really built up your prestige, 
haven't you.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Well, as the eldest daughter back home, I 
practically ran the place. It's only 
natural that things turned out this way!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
“...... Um, excuse me, what kind of older 
sister was Tamamo-san back home?”

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Well, yeah. She was supposed to be a 
pretty dependable, great big sis!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! Do you have any stories or anything? 
I wanna hear them, please!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
An episode? If that's what ya need, I've 
got a surefire hit! A crazy incident went 
down!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: —It happened in the middle of the night!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It was a day when Dad was stuck at work 
and Mom was in the hospital. Just us kids 
at home. —Then we heard some rustling out 
in the courtyard.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
Hey, do you think that's a burglar...? 
...I'm scared.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross of That Time
text_block_list.text:
......It's okay, it's gonna be okay. Big 
sis'll go check it out. You guys just 
huddle up tight in the closet.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
An' then, I tiptoed over to check where 
that rustling noise was coming from, and—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross of That Time
text_block_list.text: Who the hell are you, dumbass?!

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: MEOWW!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "It's a cat, I tell ya! Ah ha ha ha!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: —Wait! What in the world?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"T-Tamamo-san was just being such a 
wonderful big sister, so I couldn't help 
it...!"

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me, do you have more stories 
like that!? I wanna hear them!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh? Guess I got no choice, then. 
...Alright, this is back from when I was 
just a little kid.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—I went to play at the neighborhood park, 
and the little kids got lost!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I panicked, searching and chasing after 
it, and ended up totally lost in an 
unfamiliar town...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I was lucky enough to find the little 
ones, but I didn't know the way back. 
Didn't have train fare either."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I just carried the little ones and kept 
on walking. Eventually hit a road I 
knew... and finally made it home right 
around sunset."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Man, in that moment, I really thought to 
myself how glad I was to be an Umamusume. 
Gahahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aww! Ever since you were little, you were 
so... caring towards your siblings, trying 
your absolute hardest...!

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Hey, that's way too magnificent~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Told ya, didn't I? Wanna hear more? Like 
when the neighborhood bully picked on the 
little ones— well, I sorted him out in 
just one day!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I showed off this White Lightning's legs 
in the family relay at the little ones' 
sports day! Blew everyone else out of the 
water in 1st place! Gwahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Those lost siblings must have felt so 
relieved when they saw you, Tamamo-san!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Listen to me!

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Still, honestly, ever since I saw you 
protecting someone from that wild boar, my 
impression of you changed, or rather... I 
realized you can really go all out for 
someone else's sake...!

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I totally understand now why you appointed 
Tamamo-san as the leader, Tucker-san!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, of course~! Tucker-san sure has an 
eye for talent.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Fuhe... hehehe!
